findings.reason: §7 must add review.py:30-31 to its rewrite list and make the completion check line-break tolerant, or the section completes with the count still spelled five in the file whose completeness predicate already requires six.
findings.text: §7 promises no site in reckon/ still spells the dimension count as a literal and gates that with grep 'five dimension\|five-dimension\|5 dimension', but the module docstring reads "which stays the five\ndimensions" (line 30 ends "five", line 31 begins "dimensions"), a phrase a line-oriented grep cannot match and which the section's prose-site list omits, so after the six enumerated sites are rewritten the stale count survives while the completion gate passes

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §8 promotes one private primitive to write_atomically and §9 routes the remaining forks through it, so roughly nineteen re-implementations collapse behind one interface; the change reduces surface rather than spreading complexity across wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §7 consolidates the review dimension count to one home, but neither its prose-site list nor its line-oriented completion grep reaches reckon/crew/review.py:30-31, so a duplicate of the count survives the section's own gate.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1474, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §7 adds to none, §8 names its single public_definitions addition (write_atomically) and states the retired forks are private and uncounted, and §9 does the same for its inventory rule on reckon/interface_counts.py.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §8 and §9 each name the mechanism they extend and the file that owns it (reckon/_store.py:419 _write_through_sibling_temporary; reckon/interface_counts.py:76 definitions and :326 read_trees; the census predicate at docs/research/data/crew-pattern-review/code-depth/census.py:233 primitive_concepts), and §9 correctly rejects reckon/clones.py as the extension point because its reader returns token windows and holds no call.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one retained layer, write_json_atomically, is justified in §8 as the single serialisation point that is not a second owner of the mechanism, and the new work extends the existing primitive rather than wrapping it.
